استرضيا (form X)
# اِسْتَرْضَيَا (istarḍayā) /is.tar.dˤa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَرْضَى (istarḍā)
# اُسْتُرْضِيَا (usturḍiyā) /us.tur.dˤi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَرْضَى (istarḍā)
# اِسْتَرْضِيَا (istarḍiyā) /is.tar.dˤi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَرْضَى (istarḍā)
